blockers.wanted: a creak whose pitch glides 300-1100 Hz
blockers.tried: friction -> modal wood f0 600 (the documented door-hinge recipe)
blockers.workaround: modal loss 25 mixed at 0.4 under a friction -> lp filter; the modal at normal loss pins the pitch line at its resonance and the swept friction rate only fades in and out

blockers.wanted: a numeric pitch track to confirm the stick-slip pitch moves 200-1500 Hz
blockers.tried: listen pitch / pitch by tenth (YIN voiced 10-26 percent, junk values of 42-93 Hz mid-sound on a clean line)
blockers.workaround: read the spectrogram PNG and the centroid by tenth

blockers.wanted: a check that there is no impact on a continuous creak
blockers.tried: expect onsets max 3: counted 7 (the stick-slip level wobble reads as onsets)
blockers.workaround: judged no-impact from the waveform (no peak above the 9 dB crest, smooth envelope) and left the check failing; default verify passes

friction with a built-in resonator or pitch-contour field so no modal is needed
